method: Read-only live cloud-browser DOM inspection during the assessment

admissions.conclusion: Phone/email are required in source and rendered DOM. Call links exist. A source-only suspicion of broken phone validation was withheld after the rendered attribute differed. Submission success was not tested.

about.conclusion: Website verification path asks visitors to obtain details by phone. Actual licensure, accreditation and staff qualifications were not determined.

limits: Targeted inspection of Admissions and About only. No mobile emulation, full-site rendered crawl, form validation/delivery test or call-connection test.
